sloka: प्राप्तं धर्मफलं तावद्भवता नात्र संशयः ।फलमस्याप्यधर्मस्य क्षिप्रमेव प्रपत्स्यसे ।। ५.५१.२९।।।।
transliteration: prāptaṁ dharmaphalaṁ tāvadbhavatā nātra saṁśayaḥ ।phalamasyāpyadharmasya kṣiprameva prapatsyase ।। 5.51.29।।।।

translations.english: "There is no doubt you have earned merit through righteousness (dharma destroys adharma and yields sweet fruit ultimately). But now you will quickly reap the result of your unrighteousness also.
